## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue (if applicable).

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring (code reorganization or architectural refinement)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Test addition or improvement

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] My code builds cleanly via `swift build` without warnings.
- [ ] I have run `swift test` and all unit and integration tests pass.
- [ ] I have added tests that verify the new behavior or fix.
- [ ] Concurrency safety and `@MainActor` boundaries have been preserved.
- [ ] No third-party dependencies have been introduced without prior discussion.
- [ ] Documentation and comments have been updated accordingly.
